title: Nitric oxide-releasing hyaluronic acid as an antibacterial and immunomodulatory acne therapeutic
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7687-7701
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08320F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Samantha L. Picciotti, Torrance M. Jenkins, Tsian D. Ramrattan, Mark H. Schoenfisch
The dual activity of hyaluronic acid (HA) and nitric oxide (NO) elicits antibacterial activity and modulates cell proliferation, sebum production, and inflammation in vitro, representing a promising alternative to conventional acne treatment.
